command:
set +e
cd /tmp
for v in 2.4.11 2.4.12; do curl -sL -o ft-$v.tgz https://download.savannah.gnu.org/releases/freetype/freetype-old/freetype-$v.tar.gz && tar xzf ft-$v.tgz; done
diff -u freetype-2.4.11/src/base/fttrigon.c freetype-2.4.12/src/base/fttrigon.c | head -400
echo "=================== 2.4.12 fttrigon.c"
cat freetype-2.4.12/src/base/fttrigon.c | grep -v '^\s*/\*\s*\*/\s*$'
echo "=================== FT_MulFix in 2.4.12 ftcalc (64-bit?)"
grep -n "FT_LONG64\|define FT_LONG64\|FT_INT64" freetype-2.4.12/include/freetype/config/ftconfig.h | head -20
